description: Use this when the user wants a service or group on one of their status pages renamed, described differently, moved into or out of a group, or moved up or down. Returns the component as saved and the page's components in order. Not for taking one off the page: use remove_status_page_component.

component.description: The component's id or name, as get_status_page lists them.

description.description: The new text under the name; "" removes it.

group.description: The group to move it into, by name or id; "" moves it out of its group to the top level.

order.description: Its position within its group, or the top level: 0 is first.

status_page.description: The page's id, name or address.

name: update_status_page_component
title: Change a status page component
